items.question: How do I buy a ticket?
items.answer: Choose an event, select your ticket type and quantity, enter your details, and pay securely. Your QR code will appear under “My tickets”.

items.question: Can I book a table?
items.answer: Yes. From the venue or event page, choose “Book a table”, select your area, pay the deposit, and receive your QR confirmation.

items.question: How does QR entry work?
items.answer: Show the QR code from your ticket or reservation at the venue entrance. Each code is unique and non-transferable.

items.question: Can I cancel a purchase?
items.answer: Cancellations depend on each event's policy. You'll find the available options in your ticket or reservation details.

items.question: Why do you ask for my ID?
items.answer: RAVENUE is for adults 18 and over. We verify your ID automatically to help keep the community safe.

items.question: How do I list my venue?
items.answer: Open “List my venue”, enter your business details, and our team will review your application.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the RAVENUE platform and the services offered through it.
sections: 1. Acceptance
By creating an account or using RAVENUE, you accept these terms and conditions, along with our privacy and cookie policies.
2. Using the platform
RAVENUE is an adults-only platform for users aged 18 and over that connects people with events and venues. You must provide accurate information and keep your account secure.
3. Ticket purchases and bookings
Purchases and bookings are governed by each event and venue's terms. RAVENUE acts as the technology platform for their sale and management.
4. Responsibilities
Final admission to each venue is subject to its entry rules. Venues are responsible for delivering the service offered.
5. Intermediation and organizer responsibility

RAVENUE lists and sells tickets and bookings on behalf of venues and organizers without organizing the events itself. The organizer or venue is solely responsible for delivery, quality, content, capacity, safety, legal compliance, admission, and access conditions. RAVENUE is not responsible for date changes, cancellations, or organizer breaches; it routes claims under these terms and through the Complaints Book.
6. Intellectual property
All RAVENUE content, branding, and design are protected. They may not be reproduced without permission.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We explain which data we collect, why we collect it, and how we protect it.
sections: Data we collect
Registration data (name, email, ID, and phone number), purchase and booking information, and platform usage data.
How we use it
To manage your account, process purchases and bookings, verify that you're over 18, prevent fraud, and improve your experience.
Protection
Your data is stored in encrypted form and we apply security measures to prevent unauthorized access.
Your rights
You can access, correct, or request the deletion of your data by contacting us through the help center.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: We use cookies to keep the platform working properly and improve your experience.
sections: What are cookies?
Small files stored on your device to remember your preferences and keep you signed in.
Types of cookies
Essential cookies (needed for the platform to work), performance cookies (anonymous analytics), and personalization cookies (to remember filters and preferences).
Managing cookies
You can clear cookies from the footer or through your browser settings at any time.

beneficiario.title: Ultimate Beneficial Owner Statement
beneficiario.intro: In compliance with applicable regulations, RAVENUE identifies its ultimate beneficial owners.
sections: Definition
An ultimate beneficial owner is the individual who ultimately owns or controls the company that operates the platform.
Statement
RAVENUE keeps its ultimate beneficial owner information current in line with anti-money laundering regulations.
Transparency
This information is made available to the relevant authorities when required.

clausulas.title: Additional use clauses
clausulas.intro: Terms that apply when you consent to additional uses of your data.
sections: Scope
By consenting to additional uses, you authorize us to send personalized perks, promotions, and discounts.
Optional consent
This consent is optional and does not affect your use of the platform or your ability to buy tickets or make bookings.
Withdrawal
You can withdraw your consent at any time in your account settings or by contacting us through the help center.

refund_policy.title: Refund policy
refund_policy.intro: Terms that apply to refunds for tickets purchased through RAVENUE.
sections: General rule
Unless an event is canceled, tickets purchased through RAVENUE are non-refundable. Before buying, check the date, venue, and event terms.
Event cancellation
If an organizer cancels an event, we'll arrange a refund of the ticket amount through the original payment method, subject to the processor's timing.
Venue-specific policies
Each venue and event may set additional refund or exchange terms. These appear in the event details before purchase.
How to request help
For questions or requests, contact us through the help center and include your order number.
